title: Measurement and Units
summary: From handspans and angulas to the metre: why standard units matter and how to measure length accurately.

ib.note: Measurement skills are assessed throughout MYP (Criteria B and C)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 5: Measurement of Length and Motion

objectives: I can explain why standard units are needed, using body-based units as an example.
I can use SI units of length and convert between mm, cm, m and km.
I can measure length correctly, avoiding zero error and parallax error.
misconceptions: You always start reading a ruler from its end.
Where you look from doesn't matter when reading a scale.
A bigger number always means a bigger length (units matter!).
